nativeMessage: Request contains content that doesn't meet our safety guidelines, try again.
cause: ARM string(bool) produced uppercase True. Evaluation gate requires lowercase true and denied before original HTTPX send/reservation. Native RAI catches operational errors and returns its fail-closed safety message.
correction: Prepared Bicep now uses an explicit ternary yielding lowercase true/false. Native safety logic and the 12-call budget were not disabled or replaced.
scope: Deployment/evaluation configuration error, not a model content-safety verdict
